verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no official SolidJS CLI. Project scaffolding is done with `npx degit solidjs/templates`, which uses the third-party degit tool to copy a template. That is a user-side workaround, not a first-party CLI, and nothing ties it to AI-native or agentic workflows. A UI framework's ecosystem could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence means none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
